principles.name: Customer Obsession
principles.official: We start with the customer and work backwards. Tonight the customer is a bot doing 40k req/s.

principles.name: Ownership
principles.official: We never say "that's not my job." We do say "why am I on call for 14 services."

meme.bottom: IT IS NOW. ALL OF THEM.

principles.name: Invent and Simplify
principles.official: We expect innovation and simplification. sleep(5000) is both.

principles.name: Are Right, A Lot
principles.official: Strong judgment and good instincts. It was DNS.

meme.bottom: IT WAS DNS. IT IS ALWAYS DNS.

principles.name: Learn and Be Curious
principles.official: We are never done learning, especially about why production is on fire.

principles.name: Hire and Develop the Best
principles.official: We raise the bar with every hire, then add them to the on-call rotation.

meme.bottom: PUT THEM ON CALL DAY ONE

principles.name: Insist on the Highest Standards
principles.official: Relentlessly high standards. We raised the bar. And the CPU. To 98%.

principles.name: Think Big
principles.official: A bold, inspiring direction. Our incidents are now SEV-1 sized.

principles.name: Bias for Action
principles.official: Speed matters. Most decisions are reversible. Some were not.

principles.name: Frugality
principles.official: Accomplish more with less. Less sleep counts.

principles.name: Earn Trust
principles.official: We speak candidly and are vocally self-critical, e.g. "it's probably fine."

principles.name: Dive Deep
principles.official: We stay connected to the details. At 4 AM. In the logs. Alone.

principles.name: Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit
principles.official: We respectfully challenge decisions, then commit anyway. Mostly the second part.

principles.name: Deliver Results
principles.official: We deliver the key inputs with quality and on time. The result was a 503.

principles.name: Strive to be Earth's Best Employer
principles.official: A safe, productive, empowering environment. The pager is waterproof, for the shower.

principles.name: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
principles.official: Leave things better than you found them. The campsite is on fire.

meme.top: LEAVE IT BETTER THAN YOU FOUND IT

posters: Strive to be Earth's Best Employer
